name: Eagle Pose
description: Standing balance with one leg wrapped over the other and the arms wrapped in front.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Stand tall and bend both knees a little.
Shift your weight onto one foot, ready to cross the other thigh over it.

keyframes.name: Mountain Pose
keyframes.cue: Stand tall with your feet together and arms by your sides.

keyframes.name: Eagle Pose
keyframes.cue: Bend the knees, cross the right thigh over, and wrap the arms.

cues: Sit low as if in Chair Pose.
Lift the elbows to shoulder height.
